listing.name: Dino Crisis — Dino-Crisis-Modern-Edition (Rotmill)
listing.summary: The project describes Dino Crisis mods and development features. Its supported-disc setup does not establish that every enhancement or gameplay path works; Portcove has not confirmed a full playthrough. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Dino Crisis PlayStation Track 1 BIN/CUE: USA SLUS00922 v1.0/v1.1, supported PAL SLES02207–02211 with its matching SBI, Japanese SLPS02180 or the named Russian USA translation. Another Resident Evil port’s files do not establish a match.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow DinoCrisisME_Setup.exe or its unpacked setup tools with your own supported disc. It generates C code and compiles the native game and mod locally using bundled compiler, Python and PSXRecomp tools. This guide does not identify a precompiled game download.

warnings: The project describes Dino Crisis mods and development features. Its supported-disc setup does not establish that every enhancement or gameplay path works; Portcove has not confirmed a full playthrough.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
